channels.name: 00-start-here
channels.purpose: Vision, who does what, and the identities we're each stepping into.
channels.canvas:
# Pacific Focus

**Pacific Focus** exists to get Owen's book finished, published, and in front of the right readers — and to build the personal brands/platform that carry it. We're laying foundations now: a content engine, a website/funnel, a clean manuscript, and a publishing path (traditional *or* self-pub). Everyone "steps into their identity" — the public-facing version of themselves this project needs.

Channels are numbered. Tasks live as checklists/Lists inside each channel. Owners are tagged.
channels.tasks:
## Tasks

- [ ] [Team] Write the **one-paragraph vision** + the book's positioning (who it's for, the promise, why now).
- [ ] [Team] Fill the **roles & owners** table:
    - Owen — author & manuscript
    - Adoniah — website, GoHighLevel, content engine
    - Bree — book launch & PR
    - Kez — *(role held open — see #06)*
- [ ] [Team] Define the **identities each person is stepping into** — for each: voice, audience, what they want to be known for, 3 example topics:
    - [ ] [Owen] Author identity (the expert/storyteller behind the book)
    - [ ] [Adoniah] Builder/marketer identity (the one who builds the platform & systems)
    - [ ] [Bree] Launch/PR identity
- [ ] [Team] **Working agreements:** channel list, where tasks live (Lists vs checklists), weekly check-in day/time, decision-log location.

channels.name: 01-manuscript
channels.purpose: Owner: Owen (deep). Owen's editing, breakdown, and rewrite pipeline — get to a publisher-ready manuscript.
channels.canvas:
# 01 · Manuscript — Owner: Owen (deep)

Owen has a full draft and is editing → breaking it down → rewriting. This channel tracks the manuscript chapter by chapter until we have (a) a clean full draft and (b) a polished sample we can pitch.

**Status convention per chapter:** Done / Editing / Rewrite / Cut.
channels.tasks:
## Tasks

- [ ] [Owen] **Inventory the draft** — list every chapter and set a status (Done / Editing / Rewrite / Cut) in a chapter status sheet.
- [ ] [Owen] **Structural edit** — map the book's spine/outline; confirm the through-line and order; flag chapters that need a rewrite vs a light pass.
- [ ] [Owen] **Rewrite pass** — work chapter by chapter:
    - [ ] Rewrite the chapter
    - [ ] Line edit (clarity, tighten, voice)
    - [ ] Self-review checklist (does it open strong, earn its place, end with momentum?)
- [ ] [Owen] **Lock the pitch sample** — polished synopsis + the strongest 1–3 chapters, ready for publishers (feeds #02).
- [ ] [Owen] Pull **3–5 key ideas/quotes per chapter** as raw material for content (feeds #04).
- [ ] [Team] **Editor-support decision (foundation, not scheduled):** beta readers vs professional editor vs proofreader — decide what level of help the book gets.

channels.name: 02-publishing
channels.purpose: Owners: Owen + Adoniah (deep). Run agent route, paid hybrid offer, and self-publish fallback in parallel — then choose with eyes open.
channels.canvas:
# 02 · Publishing — Owners: Owen + Adoniah (deep)

We have three live options. We keep them moving in parallel and never sign anything exclusive that closes the others down.

**Golden rule:** a traditional publisher/agent pays *you*; if *you* pay *them*, it's a hybrid/paid deal — fine to consider, but scrutinise it. We converge on one track only when we hit the decision criteria below.
channels.tasks:
## Track A — Literary agents / traditional (no upfront cost — they pay us)

- [ ] [Adoniah] **Submission tracker** — log every agent/publisher submitted to: name, date sent, response, next step.
- [ ] [Owen] Assemble the **submission package:**
    - [ ] Query/pitch letter
    - [ ] Synopsis (1 page)
    - [ ] Author bio + photo
    - [ ] Sample chapters (from #01)
    - [ ] **Marketing/platform one-pager** (audience, socials, list size, launch plan — proof we can sell)
- [ ] [Owen] Keep submitting to a target list of agents that fit the genre.
- [ ] [Adoniah] **Follow-up plan** — cadence for staying on their radar without nagging.

## Track B — Paid hybrid offer (on the table — evaluate, don't rush)

> Offer received: publisher will take the book **but we pay to be published**, **royalties split 50/50**. This is a *hybrid/paid* deal, not a traditional one. Do **not** sign while Track A submissions are live, and **do not sign anything exclusive** that kills the agent route.

- [ ] [Owen]/[Adoniah] Get the **full offer + contract in writing** and log it in the tracker.
- [ ] [Team] **Evaluation checklist — answers required before considering it:**
    - [ ] Exactly what does the **fee cover** (editing, cover, ISBN, distribution, marketing — itemised)?
    - [ ] **Who owns the rights and the ISBN** — us or them?
    - [ ] **Exit clause / term length** — can we get rights back, how and when?
    - [ ] Is it **exclusive**? Does signing kill the agent submissions?
    - [ ] What's the **real distribution** — bookshops & libraries, or just an Amazon listing we could get ourselves?
    - [ ] What marketing is **contractually guaranteed** vs vaguely promised?
    - [ ] Can they show **comparable titles + actual sales numbers**?
- [ ] [Team] **Independent contract review** before signing — Society of Authors (free for members) and/or ALLi (rates hybrid publishers).
- [ ] [Team] Compare the **economics** vs Track A (free, they pay us) and Track C (we keep ~100% minus costs).

## Track C — Self-publish (fallback, kept ready)

- [ ] [Adoniah] **Platform decision** — Amazon KDP vs IngramSpark (vs both); note pros/cons for our case.
- [ ] [Adoniah] Sort **ISBN**, **cover design**, **interior formatting/typesetting**, **pricing**, and **distribution** as a ready-to-launch path.
- [ ] [Bree] *(coordinates with #05 — self-pub launch is Bree's domain)*

## Decision

- [ ] [Team] Agree **decision criteria + a date** to choose A, B, or C (so the parallel effort converges instead of running forever).
- [ ] [Team] **Guardrail:** never sign anything exclusive while other tracks are still live.

channels.name: 03-website-funnel
channels.purpose: Owner: Adoniah (deep). The website + GoHighLevel build — the home base and lead-capture engine.
channels.canvas:
# 03 · Website & Funnel — Owner: Adoniah (deep)

Adoniah builds the foundation here: a simple author website and a GoHighLevel funnel that captures readers, nurtures them, and feeds the launch list. Build it once, reuse it for the launch.
channels.tasks:
## Tasks

- [ ] [Adoniah] **Brand assets & domain** — buy the domain; lock logo, colours, fonts (shared with #04).
- [ ] [Adoniah] **GoHighLevel setup** — create the account/sub-account; connect the domain; set up email/SMS sending; connect a calendar.
- [ ] [Adoniah] **Build the foundation funnel:**
    - [ ] Home / landing page
    - [ ] Author / about page (Owen's identity from #00)
    - [ ] Book page (cover, blurb, pre-order/notify CTA)
    - [ ] **Lead magnet opt-in** (e.g. free first chapter)
    - [ ] Thank-you page + **nurture email sequence**
- [ ] [Adoniah] **CRM pipeline & tags** — set up tags (Lead / Reader / Launch list) and a simple pipeline; basic automations (deliver lead magnet, add to list).
- [ ] [Adoniah] **Tracking + waitlist** — analytics/pixels installed; a **launch-ready waitlist page** that #05-launch will reuse.

channels.name: 04-content-and-linkedin
channels.purpose: Owners: Adoniah + Owen (deep). Stand up the content engine and get Owen's LinkedIn going.
channels.canvas:
# 04 · Content & LinkedIn — Owners: Adoniah + Owen (deep)

This is the foundation that builds the audience before launch. Optimise Owen's LinkedIn to his author identity, then run a repeatable content engine (idea → draft → review → schedule) drawing material from the book.
channels.tasks:
## Tasks

- [ ] [Owen] + [Adoniah] **Optimise Owen's LinkedIn profile** to the author identity:
    - [ ] Headline
    - [ ] About section
    - [ ] Banner image
    - [ ] Featured (book / lead magnet link)
- [ ] [Adoniah] **Stand up the content engine:**
    - [ ] Content **pillars/themes** (3–5, tied to the book)
    - [ ] **Content calendar** + posting cadence
    - [ ] **Capture/production workflow** (idea → draft → Owen review → schedule)
    - [ ] **Repurposing** flow (one idea → post + email + short-form)
    - [ ] Pick the **scheduler/tooling**
- [ ] [Adoniah] + [Owen] **First foundation content batch:**
    - [ ] Intro / "stepping into the author identity" post
    - [ ] Book-journey series (writing → rewriting → publishing)
    - [ ] Value posts pulled from chapter ideas/quotes (#01)
- [ ] [Adoniah] Define the **metrics that matter** (followers, engagement, opt-ins) — to watch foundations, not to hit targets yet.

channels.name: 05-launch
channels.purpose: Owner: Bree (lighter for now). Hold the book-launch plan — activates once the publishing path is chosen.
channels.canvas:
# 05 · Launch — Owner: Bree (lighter for now)

Bree owns the launch (especially if we self-publish). For now we keep it light and just build the launch list via the website. The dated launch plan waits until the publishing path is decided (#02).
channels.tasks:
## Tasks

- [ ] [Bree] **Launch concept** — angle, channels, and what a great launch looks like (placeholder until path is chosen).
- [ ] [Bree] + [Adoniah] **Grow the launch list** via the #03 waitlist page.
- [ ] [Bree] Start an **outreach / ARC / review-team idea list** (who could endorse, review, or amplify).

## 🅿️ Parking lot (deferred)

- Dated launch timeline & runbook — *blocked on the #02 publishing decision.*
